u1-l55.conditions: The teacher supplies the task, duration, permitted resources, assistance, collection and feedback-release rules. This public deck is a briefing, not an assessment paper or marking key. Keep any supported clinic separate; it does not replace the school task.

plan.title: School-issued theory task and conditions
plan.activity: Use the teacher-issued theory task under its approved local conditions. Show only the briefing during the attempt; collect work before any released discussion. Public scenario practice is a separate supported clinic, not a replacement assessment.
plan.objective: Apply taught network reasoning under the school-issued task conditions.

u1-l61.conditions: Public revision sample, not a secure assessment or grade predictor. Record prior exposure. Use questions only: no answers, examples, code execution or partner help during the independent window. If support is used, stop the independent clock and label that work supported. The two-session suggestion is 5 minutes reading plus 40 + 15 working minutes; record actual time and any interruption.

plan.title: Questions-only timed practice: first session
plan.activity: Brief conditions and record prior exposure; use unit1-practice-paper.md questions only. Allow 5 minutes reading and 40 working minutes in this session. Preserve work without feedback for the remaining 15 working minutes in Lesson 2. Prior-seen questions are repeat practice, not fresh evidence.
plan.objective: Attempt the public Unit 1 revision sample independently before seeing question-specific explanations.

u1-l62.conditions: Continue the preserved attempt for 15 working minutes before any question-specific model or key. Stop and preserve the original responses before revealing feedback. Record actual combined time and prior exposure. Later corrections are supported; a changed retry is separate evidence. This split classroom activity is not a continuous formal examination.

plan.title: Finish and preserve the attempt, then review
plan.activity: Resume questions only for 15 working minutes; stop and preserve all original responses. Then release explanations, identify causes, write supported corrections and try a changed example with the key closed. Do not finish the original as an independent attempt after feedback.
plan.objective: Separate the timed original response from explained correction and a changed independent retry.
